prompt: Show live captions during video calls for attendees who are hard of hearing.
why: Speech recognition turns speech into text (Azure Speech).
trap: No language change is needed, so it's not translation.

prompt: Warehouse workers say 'next order' and 'mark shipped' instead of tapping a screen.
why: Recognizing spoken commands is speech to text.
trap: A multimodal model could work, but simple command recognition is speech to text.

prompt: Turn 5,000 hours of recorded sales calls into searchable text.
why: Batch transcription is speech to text.
trap: Content Understanding adds structure, but the ask here is just text.

prompt: Transcripts keep getting drug names wrong in a pharmacy's recorded calls, so the team adds a list of product terms.
tells: adds a list of product terms
why: Custom speech models or phrase lists improve recognition of domain words.
trap: The words are wrong at transcription, before any text analysis.

prompt: Doctors dictate notes after each visit, and the app writes them into the patient record.
trap: Summarizing could come later; first the speech becomes text.

prompt: Meeting transcripts need to show who said each line.
why: Speaker diarization in speech to text labels who spoke when.
trap: Content Understanding returns structured fields; this is a labeled transcript.
